Comfort feels safe, but it’s never made anyone better. 💪

Today’s exercise: resistance band, a weighted jump onto the bench, and a single-leg landing. Every rep is a test. Your legs shake, your balance wobbles, and your brain is telling you to put the other foot down.

That’s exactly the point.

After 18 years as a pro, here’s what I know for sure: the moments that change you are the ones that feel the hardest. Not the easy sessions, not the days you feel great. The days you turn up anyway and lean into the discomfort.

Single-leg work like this builds more than strength. It builds control, stability and confidence in your body. It protects your knees and ankles, sharpens your reactions, and carries over into everything from sport to chasing your kids round the park.

If you want to try it:

✅ Start without weight and nail the landing first
✅ Land softly, knee tracking over your toes
✅ Hold the landing for 2 to 3 seconds before the next rep
✅ Quality over quantity, every time
✅ Choose a smaller bench if you are a beginner and build up

And if you’re not there yet, that’s fine. Nobody starts there. Start where you are, wobble a bit, and come back tomorrow a little stronger.

Growth lives on the other side of uncomfortable. Go and find it. 🔥

Tag someone who needs this push today 👇

#strength #balance #power

Asian inspired sirloin steak cook along 🥩👌🏻

Ingredients:

Sirloin steak
Grated ginger 
Grated garlic 
Finely chopped red chilli 
The juice of a lime 
2 tbsp soy sauce 
2 tbsp honey 
1 tbsp sesame oil 
Extra virgin olive oil

To garnish:

Sesame seeds 
Smoked sea salt or salt of choice

Method:

1) Add the ginger, garlic, chilli, soy sauce, lime juice sesame oil, and honey to a bowl along with the steak. Rub the marinade into the steak really well. If you have time, allow to marinade for 20-30 minutes. 
2) Heat a pan on a medium heat, add a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil followed by the steak. Cook for 2 minutes each side. 
3) Pour over the remaining marinade and cook for a further 30 seconds. 
4) Remove the steak from the pan and spoon over the marinade. 
5) Allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing. 
6) Enjoy 😉

Fatigue tests your focus. Repetition builds it. 💪⚽

Myself and @chazdaniels11 loved playing on the left together and spent years pushing each other on a daily basis to become better. 

This session was a burner - 1v1s, 4 blocks of 2 minutes. Sounds easy, but by the third block your legs are heavy, your lungs are burning and your decisions start to slip. That’s when concentration really counts. Anyone can do it fresh. Can you still pick the right moment, take the right touch and commit when you’re tired? As you can see in the clip, the defending wasn’t great by either of us, and when you get tired, it is easy to dive in and make silly decisions. 

Every mistake on the training ground is a lesson you won’t have to learn on matchday. Don’t be scared of making mistakes, just learn from them and become better and stronger from those experiences 🔥💪🏻

Two things I’ve always believed in:

🔁 Repetition. Keep sharpening the things you’re good at. Your strengths are what get you noticed, so make them automatic.

🎯 Work even harder on your weaknesses. It’s not comfortable, but it’s what separates good players from great ones. Your opponent will find your weak spot, so make sure there isn’t an easy one.

Shoutout to @matt_best13  @roblloyd_96 and @maxwhittingham - can’t remember which one of you decided to run us into the ground on this occasion… a session I won’t forget in a hurry - good times 🔥😂

What are you going to work on this week to improve? Let me know in the comments below ⬇️ 

#football #footballer #mindset #repetition

Today’s @lfeonline nutrition workshop was an absolute joy. The @bristolcityfcacademy lads applied themselves brilliantly 🔴⚪ 

After a presentation which focused on fuelling for elite performance and recovery, we made barbacoa chicken tortillas with an orange, ginger, garlic, chilli, and honey glaze 🌮🔥

Recipe and method below ⬇️ 

What you’ll need (serves 4):
• 8 boneless chicken thighs
• 2 tbsp barbacoa spice blend
• Pinch of salt
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 100ml orange juice
• 2 garlic cloves, crushed
• 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated
• 1 red chilli, finely chopped
• 1-2 tbsp honey
• 4 wholemeal tortillas
• 2 golden kiwis, sliced
• Pomegranate seeds

Method:
1️⃣ Coat the chicken in the barbacoa spice, salt and olive oil
2️⃣ Heat the pan and fry the chicken for 5 minutes each side
3️⃣ While it cooks, mix the orange juice, garlic, ginger, chilli and honey
4️⃣ Pour the marinade over the chicken for the last 3 to 4 minutes and let it go sticky
5️⃣ Slice and load onto a warm wholemeal tortilla
6️⃣ Top with golden kiwi and pomegranate

Protein for repair, slow-release carbs for energy and plenty of vitamin C to help recovery 💪 Simple food that does the job.

Great energy from the boys today, well done all 👏

Also, a massive thank you to @bakerjodie @jackloveiow @charliebarks101 for being so accommodating. The lads are blessed to have you ❤️🙏🏼

Chicken Chilli Con Carne 🌶️

The clocks have gone back, the nights are drawing in, and this is what I love to eat at this time of year 🌶️🔥

Chicken Chilli Con Carne. A big bowl of comfort that is highly nutritious for you.

Here’s why it’s a winter staple in my house:

🍗 Lean chicken protein: helps repair and rebuild muscle after training, and keeps you fuller for longer
🫘 Kidney beans: slow-release carbs for steady energy, plus plenty of fibre to keep your gut happy
🍅 Tomatoes: rich in lycopene, and cooking them actually helps your body absorb more of it
🫑 Peppers and onions: packed with vitamin C, which supports your immune system just as cold and flu season kicks in
🌶️ Chilli, cumin and paprika: warmth, flavour and a natural metabolism nudge, without loading up on salt or sauces

One pot. Easy to batch cook. Even better the next day 🙌

When it’s cold and dark, it is important to have go-to meals in your locker that are warming, simple and full of goodness. This is one of them meals that you will want to eat on repeat. 

Full recipe is on The Foodie Footballer website, click the link in my bio and select “free recipes” and search for chicken chilli con carne 👌🏻

Save this recipe and give me a tag when you make it - I’m sure you will love it 🔥🔥

#chilli #chicken #health
